newsitem.title: UK: LME metals hold most of gains in late session.
newsitem.headline: LME metals hold most of gains in late session.

text.p: Copper prices held earlier gains during the Wednesday evening session on the London Metal Exchange (LME) on fears of further tightness coming into the market, traders said.
At 1700 GMT three months copper was indicated at $2,333/$2,335, about $6 off its late kerb close and aluminium was a couple of dollars firmer at $1,605/$1,608.
Copper finished the kerb just short of an 8-1/2 month high of $2,360 touched during the morning but still $54 positive on the day in a market which traders described as nervous.
Zinc was unchanged from its kerb close of $1,230/$1,232 after reaching a two-year high of $1,235 earlier on the back of copper's rally.
There was virtually no movement in the other metal prices.
